text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognising images, and making decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI where computers learn from data instead of following clear instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks. Today, AI is used in many daily activities. For example, it helps recommend films on streaming services, translates languages, and powers voice assistants on our phones. AI is also used in medicine and transport. It is changing the way we live and work.
